position: Local Node Source API first; production launch still closed
headline: The next backend move is deliberately small.
copy: The spike should prove source packet shape, no-source behavior, and local demo flow before any live retrieval or AI generation is allowed.

postures.title: Local Node API
postures.copy: Fastest way to wrap the existing source stub without changing the GitHub Pages product.

postures.title: Serverless function
postures.copy: Useful after packet contracts are stable and deployment secrets are defined.

postures.title: Separate service repo
postures.copy: Too much structure before the source packet contract is proven.

postures.title: Live AI answers
postures.copy: No generated answer pipeline opens in this batch.

postures.title: Public launch
postures.copy: Rights, privacy, reviewer operations, security, and support still need real systems.

flow.title: Pick
flow.copy: Use the local Node Source API spike.

flow.title: Wrap
flow.copy: Expose health, source, and fixture endpoints.

flow.title: Test
flow.copy: Assert every packet field before UI integration.

flow.title: Demo
flow.copy: Run the private handoff with launch locks visible.

decisions.label: Backend path
decisions.reason: It protects simplicity and avoids premature infrastructure.

decisions.label: Storage
decisions.reason: The spike returns packets; it does not store users, reviewers, or telemetry.

decisions.label: Corpus
decisions.reason: Reviewed fixture records remain the only source set.

decisions.label: Launch
decisions.reason: Private demo readiness is not public launch readiness.

locks.title: Live AI lock
locks.copy: No live model call is enabled by this release.

locks.title: Storage lock
locks.copy: No durable user, reviewer, telemetry, or account storage is created.

locks.title: Rights lock
locks.copy: No licensed source text delivery is assumed.

locks.title: Authority lock
locks.copy: VedaPath remains source-backed study and reflection support, not a guru or clinician.

locks.title: Launch lock
locks.copy: No account, payment, live model, telemetry, or licensed corpus path opens here.

packet:
Backend Spike Choice v4.7.1
Decision: local Node Source API first.
Reason: prove source packet shape before real retrieval or AI generation.
Blocked: public launch, production storage, accounts, payments, live model calls, licensed corpus delivery.
